status: Elementary counterexamples and experiment implications, not new theorems or scene results.

soft_tiers_are_not_feasibility.result: The violating candidate gets the higher weighted score in this example. Positive affine final normalization preserves ordering.
soft_tiers_are_not_feasibility.boundary: Not a reproduction of ThinkBLOX results or its selected weights; normalization and tier names alone give no strict feasibility guarantee.
soft_tiers_are_not_feasibility.consequence: Keep actual required-object/geometry checks separate from learned or weighted scores; unknown checks remain unknown.

greedy_reasoning_is_not_marginal_decisio.result: Greedy decision then greedy action selects action 0; the marginal action mode is action 1.
greedy_reasoning_is_not_marginal_decisio.boundary: Does not show that more reasoning harms our model. It blocks a universal guarantee from the factorization alone.

source_to_method_difference.auxiliary_control: Official Distilling step-by-step separates label and rationale tasks. Our action/decision weighted causal objective is an adaptation, not an exact T5 reproduction or a new loss.
source_to_method_difference.reason_then_act: ThinkBLOX already trains progressive 3D reason-and-place sequences. Furniture D-to-A conditioning is not itself new.
source_to_method_difference.candidate_estimand: Final full-room quality at fixed total cost, or cost to matched quality, for self-generated D conditioning versus auxiliary-D/direct-A learning with the same original supervision.
source_to_method_difference.important_control: Direct-A plus additional ordinary candidate search must receive the saved inference budget; identical output caps alone do not imply equal cost.
source_to_method_difference.data_limit: 24 units / 6 development families / 10 original decisions; 14 action-only units do not train the conditioned pathway. No new labels created or units deleted.
source_to_method_difference.not_yet_identified: No established three-dimensional inductive bias beyond ordinary rationale supervision/conditioning; a positive tiny pilot would justify investigation, not a CVPR novelty claim.
